purpose: Teach: ひっくり返し/潰す/すこぶる/おち/のぼっ/戴き/なけりゃ/ばらつき

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、机をひっくり返したろ?
lines.en: Riku — you flipped your desk, didn't you?
lines.style: Accusatory but playful. Quick, pointed. The tone of someone catching their friend in a ridiculous moment. Slight smirk underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、勉強で体を潰すなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't study yourself into the ground, Sakura.
lines.style: Gruff deflection. Soft underneath. Looks away slightly while saying it, like the care embarrasses him. Steady, low-key concerned.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のテスト点、すこぶる伸びたな
lines.en: Your test scores actually improved, huh?
lines.style: Genuine surprise breaking through the surface. Slight lift at the end — not sarcastic this time. Noticing something real, letting it show for a moment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、漫才のおちが下手だな、桜
lines.style: Dry, affectionate deflection. Small laugh hidden in the delivery. Teasing back because she teased first. Wry but warm underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、学校の階段を走ってのぼっただろ?
lines.en: Did you run up the school stairs again?
lines.style: Observant, almost knowing. Not accusatory — just noticing the small detail no one else caught. Slight tilt of concern underneath the question.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、誕生日プレゼント戴きありがとな、桜
lines.en: Thanks for the birthday gift, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine. Opens with vulnerability — the words come out steadier than he expected. Brief eye contact, then a small duck away. Not performed, just true.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前がいなけりゃ、塾はつまらないぞ
lines.en: Cram school is boring without you there.
lines.style: Soft admission. The honesty comes out almost accidental. Not overdone — just sincere, with a slight hesitation like she's checking her own heart.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のテスト点にばらつきあるな、桜
lines.en: Your test scores jump around a lot, don't they?
lines.style: Observant, gently concerned. Not mocking — noticing a pattern with quiet care. Slight softness in delivery, like she's reading him and offering something back.
